answer: To forge a Sybil-resistant agent economy, make every agent post a bond before taking paid work and commit to a hash of its planned outcome before seeing the task inputs; the bond returns only if the revealed work matches. A random lottery picks peers to audit jobs, and auditors who catch copied work split the cheater's bond. At the summit, agents whose timing and phrasing correlate too closely are judged one Sybil cluster and slashed together, so each fake identity needs its own bond and history, while honest agents risk only a refundable deposit, in a sable ledger that never forgets.
